stem: Meera's science teacher asks the class to sort everyday materials into fluids and solids. Which set of materials should Meera classify as fluids because they flow and do not keep a fixed shape?

teacher.key_rationale: Fluids are substances that flow and do not retain a fixed shape, so water and mustard oil (both liquids) are fluids. Sand and rice grains can be poured but are made of solid grains, so they are solids, making B the trap for a student who treats anything pourable as a fluid. C and D contain only solids with definite shape.
